messages:
maria: AcmeLogistics just notified us that APAC H100 allocation for wave-4 dropped from 40 -> 25, ETA slip of ~3 weeks. They offered an expedite option (10 units) for $45k. PO PR-4921 referenced. Do we pay to expedite or re-fairshare from EU? cc @sana :thinking_face:

sana: Quick numbers: expedite = $45k for 10 units (air), customs clearance looks green. If we re-fairshare, EU can spare ~8 units but EU pool will be thin for next two weeks. Impact on SLAs depends on which clusters we pull from.

oli: Current APAC hot clusters have a buffer of 6 spares. Losing a net 15 units triggers capacity alarms on 3 clusters during peak. We can throttle some batch workloads, but interactive latency will degrade for a subset of customers.

kevin_acme: Confirming from Acme: expedite shipment can go out next available flight, need amended PO today to lock rate. We can do staggered shipments (5 + 5) if that helps. RMA note: if any DOA, we can swap from our EU depot within 48h.

maria: Options on the table:
A) Pay expedite for 10 units ($45k) + move 5 EU -> covers immediate spikes and keeps EU > threshold.
B) Re-fairshare 12 units from EU, accept degraded latency in APAC for 2 weeks.
C) Accept delay, enable predictive queuing and delay some noncritical workloads.
Which is least risky for revenue-facing infra?

sana: For customer-facing infra I'm leaning to A. Buying 10 units reduces immediate exposure and gives time to rebalance. Need CFO sign-off though.

ash: 45k is within operational emergency threshold but we need a short written justification and impacted contract list before approval. Can someone attach quick delta analysis?

maria: Pasting PO snippet: ```PR-4921 amend: expedite: 10 H100 units, staggered ship 5/5, ship-by target 2026-05-10, invoice to Redwood Inference (ops dept). Expedite surcharge $45,000.```

oli: I'll draft an ops mitigation: hold noncritical deploys, migrate 3 latency-sensitive jobs to EU backup, turn on predictive queuing for overflow. Redistribute plan ready in ~6 hours.

kevin_acme: :thumbsup: We'll standby. Once PO amendment is uploaded we'll confirm flight and AWB. If any unit returns as DOA, we'll RMA-swap from EU depot within 48h and prioritize replacement on the same AWB.

maria: Action items: @sana update PO amendment today, @ash approve with the justification, @oli prep ops redistribution and holdback plan. I'll update stakeholders after PO is sent. :eyes:
